description: brink-desktop main window: core + the folder-picker dialog. File I/O goes through the shell's own guarded commands, not the fs plugin. `core:window:allow-destroy` is not in `core:window:default` (#2370) — the quit path needs it to force-close the window after the awaited save, bypassing another `closeRequested` round-trip. There is no shell/process-execution grant here and nothing to grant it to: the `brink-cli` sidecar was deleted (`docs/desktop-ota-spec.md` Stage 1) and the intl operations it existed for run in the wasm, so this shell spawns no subprocess at all.
